name: Paired Temporal Verification / Independent Search Reauthorization
paired_controls: Each scenario shares the exact publication tape, source issue clocks, private latency, oracle trajectory, action metadata, lifetime budgets and authority between arms. Only the evaluation TTL and named policy differ. TTL cannot exceed source validity.
preregistration: All scenario claims, policies and the calendar were declared before first execution. Claim support/refutation is research output, distinct from architectural conformance. No post-hoc threshold adjustment. The first run will be retained even if an implementation defect requires correction.

hypotheses.claim: Deadline-aware ordering can improve simultaneous coverage at fixed TTL
Deadline awareness guarantees timely complete verification
At fixed tape and acquisition schedule, longer favorable TTL can prolong false assurance
Independent renewal can restore an exhausted time corridor
Renewal neither replenishes lifetime budgets nor relaxes privacy or scope
Independent authorization can become a costly bottleneck or useless chain

invariants: Evaluation TTL Cannot Extend Source Validity
metric_method: Equal fixed calendar ticks, including passive observation after search stop. Search-stop state is distinct from horizon state. Authority review cost is separate from search cost.
